sourceRequirements.requirement: Public controlled snapshots and omitted/empty baseline
sourceRequirements.correspondence: Confirmed owner arrays stay authoritative. Reopen/Cancel rehydrate current snapshots; held Apply does not confirm drafts. Metadata rebase keeps dirty raw clauses and absent criteria.

Apply normalizes only its payload before requesting close; a throwing callback prevents close. Cancel restores confirmed state; Clear edits the draft; Close requests dismissal only. Current callbacks and availability are rechecked.

Complete criteria arrays, including an empty string key, own membership. Used criteria are excluded; defaultDirection/Ascending, named stable IDs, queryKey are retained, and unchanged rows retain their identity/order.
Ascending/Descending and removal request current row IDs without adopting owner state. Explicit item keys/textValue feed TagGroup; original native action/tooltip hosts remain.

Explicit items own complete ordered membership, value, stable keys and semantic text. NativeCollectionBuilder is the flat publisher, not a hidden JSX hierarchy; custom CollectionRoot uses the current real receiver contract.

Current collection object/model/window/ref admission, payload text/plain, keyboard/virtual/native reorder, drop indicators, preview/chooser and focused/persisted keys are retained. No replacement by only visible Move controls.

Both selectors receive explicit current items/getKey/getTextValue and null selection. Existing Select child-window admission remains authoritative. Labels request original registered refs through focusNativeTarget; retained stale label callbacks retire after replacement.

Stable group/clause IDs preserve repeat conditions, operation order, joins and removal. Absent metadata and raw drafts survive; explicit tag text/keys and ordinary ScrollViews replace no collection or form discovery.

Text, number, Boolean Checkbox/Toggle, scalar/range temporal, Select/ComboBox/TagComboBox/Typeahead argument shapes retain zero/false/empty and incomplete drafts. No unsupported editor fallback or core-editor/ref/IME promise is waived.

sourceRequirements.requirement: Root chrome defaults and stock dimensions
sourceRequirements.publicSurface: title, height, width, horizontalGap, position, panelGeometry, raised, overlayBlur
sourceRequirements.correspondence: Default title, height100%, width350/right, raised/blur remain. Height/width use approved stock RN numeric/percentage/auto dimensions. No browser sizing evaluator or implicit native typography inheritance is restored.

Panel owns dismissal, focus target readiness/acknowledgment, containment and return. Dialog/shell/backdrop stay out of sequential Tab order while criteria controls retain original eligibility. Native focus completion is separate from a request.

sourceRequirements.requirement: Original style owners and text context
sourceRequirements.correspondence: Modal/overlay/dialog owners remain separate. Defined override/reset precedence and original held editor identity survive metadata/theme changes. Owned text receives explicit JS context; raw custom RN text must be styled explicitly.

sourceRequirements.requirement: Complete label defaults and semantic text
sourceRequirements.correspondence: Partial and explicit empty strings preserve defaults/formatter identity. Owned footer controls now receive resolved accessibilityLabel directly, with the same visible Text, callbacks and empty-string behavior. Selects, tags and sort options retain explicit semantic text.

sourceRequirements.requirement: Native IDs and unsupported root ref
sourceRequirements.correspondence: Explicit testID wins over alias/default. The root continues to expose criteria targets rather than a public root ref. Native type tests reject browser viewport CSS and unsupported focus/Boolean renderer choices.
Canonical authored children remain unused in this compound view; no new slot or child discovery contract is introduced.

Default empty scene remains. Load/Clear confirmed query controls expose two sort rows, zero/false filter values and exact current owner snapshots for installed reorder/Apply/Cancel. Existing metadata/theme/echo/backdrop controls remain.

sharedDependencies.request: Reconcile stock RN Panel layout, window/focus, backdrop opt-in and dismissal source evidence at the adopted candidate identity. No Panel or overlay change is requested by this lane.

Supply current full argument/operation/temporal/multi-value dispatcher and original-editor composition proof, including all current core Input/NumberInput/date and ComboBox/Typeahead source dependencies. This lane changes no Filtering behavior.

Reconcile exact explicit-model/current-real-receiver, native focus/press/default/IME, field semantics and full drag/transfer dependencies; retain current admission and no-refused-action-replay behavior. Owned label wiring uses existing focusNativeTarget/useNativeCollectionRefs only.
Retain existing live theme and owned-control typography, semantic-label, action and original-host contracts in current shared evidence.

remainingNativeObligations: Current exact-product original-editor/IME/keyboard Apply/Close and native focus acknowledgments
Current native pointer/keyboard/AT reorder/drop/chooser/preview and offscreen receiver behavior
Default/override pixels, stock layout, nested scrolling, blur and live theme/profile observations
All original G02/G04/G07/G08/G09 gates; source/mock/compiler checks do not qualify an installed product
ledgerDisposition: Unchanged; no automatic PASS, failure erasure or cell-count change.
